title: Antibiotic-induced Disruption of the Microbiota
brief_summary: The use of antibiotics causes profound changes in the microbiota. However, the magnitude of the effect of intrapartum and early-life antibiotics on the breast milk and the infant oral and intestinal microbiota, and whether effects are only short-term or persist long-term remain uncertain and will be determined in this study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* healthy infants
* term infants (\> 37 weeks of gestation)

Exclusion Criteria:

* maternal HIV infection
* maternal hepatitis B or C infection
* antibiotics in the third trimester of pregnancy
* intake of probiotics during pregnancy
* infants with the low birth weight \<2500 g
* infants with congenital abnormality
study_population: Women who give birth at the Hôpital fribourgeois (HFR) in Fribourg, Switzerland and their infants.
